scenario.title: Test 5: Tenure Too Short (< 3 Years)
dialogue: Yes, original papers are in my bank locker.
Salaried, salary comes in ICICI bank.
I only want it for 2 years.

final_state.disqualification_reason: Requested tenure of 2 years is outside eligible window (3–15 years).

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Deepak Joshi, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Deepak Joshi?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, original papers are in my bank locker.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you please clarify whether you are salaried or self-employed?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Salaried, salary comes in ICICI bank.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I only want it for 2 years.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you for sharing your tenure preference, Deepak Joshi. Our pre-approved Loan Against Property program offers repayment tenures strictly between 3 to 15 years. Since you are looking for 2 years, we cannot accommodate this tenure under the current scheme. Thank you for speaking with Home Credit!
